summary: Rust clients preserve detail-refusal messages and their non-retryable behavior.

schema.detail: No database schema or index change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or retention change.

compatibility.detail: Handles the two typed observer/subscription detail refusal codes in the Rust client exhaustive plain-message match, displaying the existing server message and retaining nontransient behavior when retryable is false. Templates and checked-in output agree; client error documentation lists both existing codes. No new wire code, status, retry policy, cap or admission change.

downtime.detail: No restart or interruption beyond ordinary deployment.

recovery.detail: No writer, checkpoint or rollback changes; existing source data is preserved.
